sources.title: Entry Arrangements for Mainland, Macao, Taiwan & Overseas Chinese Residents
sources.officialityEvidence: Published on the Hong Kong Immigration Department's immd.gov.hk domain.
sources.supportingExcerpt: PRC passport holders should apply for an entry permit for social and business visits to Hong Kong.

policies.title: PRC passport holders: entry permit for social and business visits
policies.summary: Holders of People's Republic of China passports must obtain an entry permit for social and business visits to Hong Kong.
conditions: Applies to social and business visits by holders of People's Republic of China passports.
The source separately allows up to seven days entry-permit-free only for qualifying transit with onward travel.

unresolved.reason: Not established: the Immigration Department gives visit concessions by Macao residence card or Visit Permit, while Macao SAR passports are expressly described only for qualifying seven-day transit.

Not established: the published arrangements apply to Chinese residents of Taiwan and distinguish pre-arrival registration, Mainland Travel Permits, place of birth, and other travel documents; they do not provide one ordinary Taiwan-passport rule.
Not established: the current Immigration Department nationality dataset does not name Timor-Leste; its residual other-foreign-countries row cannot be used to infer this passport pair.
Not established: no direct current Hong Kong official source located maps Kosovo ordinary passports to a visitor entry category; the residual nationality row cannot establish it.
